classification.reason: Pinned legacy has authenticated create/get/deactivate routes, current service writes learner-owned image collections and mutates active state, and controller verifies learner access plus storage path ownership.

fieldMappings.legacyMeaning: surrogate row for one learner image collection
fieldMappings.redesign: The legacy collection row is decomposed into one normalized row per image; each vNext image UUID is the canonical image identifier.

fieldMappings.legacyMeaning: string learner owner ID used by create/read/deactivate
fieldMappings.redesign: Resolve authenticated canonical learner membership server-side; never trust a client learner ID as ownership.

Normalize each array entry. row id replaces imageId; receipt-backed object identity replaces arbitrary imageUrl persistence; is_active/deactivated_at replaces integer active; display_order preserves list ordering.

embeddedEntryMappings.rule: Expose canonical UUID/string as API image identifier; do not preserve random 12-char legacy format as a DB requirement.

embeddedEntryMappings.target: profile_private_document_receipts private object identity; URL derived by authorized delivery policy
embeddedEntryMappings.rule: Canonical DB state must not be an arbitrary client URL. Legacy controller already constrained URLs/storage keys to the learner profile-images folder.
Deactivate is a state transition, not hard delete. false requires deactivated_at; active rows require null deactivated_at.
Preserve deterministic presentation order with nonnegative integer ordering.

requiredDatabaseInvariants: learner_membership_id must reference the canonical owning college membership.
receipt FK must bind receipt_id + learner_membership_id + PROFILE_IMAGE purpose, preventing cross-owner attachment.
one receipt cannot be attached twice to the same learner.
storage object identity comes from a verified receipt, not arbitrary request URL text.
apiCompatibility: Create accepts one or more learner-owned image objects and returns learner plus image list.
Deactivate targets one image identifier and is idempotent/no-cross-owner.
Authorization must resolve the authenticated learner/current membership server-side; administrators require explicit profile permission rather than forged learnerId.
Public or signed URL rendering is a delivery-policy decision; it is not the canonical persisted object identity.
